caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden table or desk with a light to medium brown finish. The table has four straight, tapered legs, one at each corner, and features two front-facing drawers, each with a single round wooden knob in the center. The main color visible is brown, with darker shading indicating the grain and edges of the wood. Surrounding the main perspective illustration are two black-and-white technical sketches: one in the upper left shows the end view of the table with dimensions, and the other in the lower right shows the front view with further measurements. The overall composition presents the colored table in a three-dimensional view centered on the page, with the technical line drawings providing additional structural details. The signature "Fairbanks" appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
